name: Nguruvilu
description: A serpentine water creature of Mapuche folklore in Chile and Argentina with a fox-like head and snake-like body, blamed for drownings in lakes, rivers, and treacherous fords.

aliases.name: Ngarrafilu
aliases.region: Neuquén Province, Argentina (Limay River, Aluminé Lake)

aliases.name: Lord of the water
aliases.meaning: Euphemism used to avoid speaking the creature's true name

origin: Lakes, rivers, and water crossings in Mapuche cultural territory across southern Chile and southwestern Argentina.
